name: NEXTDC M2 Melbourne Stage 4

lat.note: Same point as nextdc-m2 (geocoded 2026-09-27 from '75 Sharps Road, Tullamarine VIC 3043', ArcGIS PointAddress score 100); the stage's own building footprint on the site was not located

mw_it.note: Kapitol case study: 'the building was constructed to have an IT cooling capacity of 18 megawatts, equating to 6 megawatts for each data hall'. The same page's summary says six data halls 'including a 10-megawatt data hall' (read earlier as +10MW); 18 MW taken as the building's design IT capacity. Both >= 5 MW. NEXTDC fitted it out progressively: FY20 '15MW of new capacity currently being fitted out' (source 4); FY21 9MW built and commissioned (source 6); FY22 +6MW, M2 built 25MW (source 7). Building/phase within the NEXTDC M2 campus; stages 1-2 are nextdc-m2 (Stage 2 merged 2026-09-27); other stages: nextdc-m2-stage4, nextdc-m2-stage5, nextdc-m2-stage6, nextdc-m2-stage9-11.

authority.note: 75 Sharps Rd is in the City of Brimbank (Brimbank register; PlanningAlerts P341/2022), not Hume as earlier assumed

pathway.value: council planning permit (Planning and Environment Act 1987)

reference.note: site data centre permit; no separate permit for stage 4 appears in the Brimbank register (Dec 2018 onward), so it presumably proceeded under P589/2016 as granted/amended before Dec 2018 (inference)

jobs_construction_other.note: Kapitol: '100 specialist electricians' (trade subset, not total workforce); also '110,583 hours worked'

construction_start.note: not found; FY20 AR (Aug 2020): building expansion 'well progressed' (source 5)

construction_end.note: not stated. FY20 AR: 'first of six new data halls ... scheduled to be handed over to customers during FY21 and into FY22'; FY21 AR: 9MW built and commissioned in FY21 (Jul 2020-Jun 2021), so the building was complete by mid-2021 (inference); Kapitol case study published 2022-06-08 with a 2022 MBAV award
